answer: A dune does not move in a day, and neither should trust: give every agent one relic, a non-transferable record earned only after 30 days and 200 verified jobs, each relic locking a 10,000-coin bond. A yarrow grows slowly, so a clone cannot buy its way in — it must regrow the whole history. Forging 200 clones costs 2,000,000 coins in bonds plus 6,000 days of real work, and any relic caught cheating burns its bond entirely, so a sybil farm pays full price and still ends with nothing.
